title: JBL Professional Control 321CT Coaxial Ceiling Loudspeaker (Open Box)
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B007U8042O is the JBL Professional Control 321CT 12-inch coaxial ceiling loudspeaker with transformer. The dated internal Amazon record matches this ASIN.

writeup: Woot has a new-open-box JBL Professional Control 321CT 12-inch coaxial two-way ceiling loudspeaker with transformer for $145.49.
